notes.title: Explosive Moltov Update is Here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740118/39874e85e3cca8770471d475bea9e83c27209bf3.jpgPatch Notes - Version 1.4  

New Content  
  
Weapons:  
[olist]  
 Added Pirate Musketoon.  
 Introduced Molotovs for explosive gameplay.  
[/olist]  
World Additions:  
[olist]  
 Treasure chests are now scattered across the island. Use them to replenish ammo and craft Molotovs.  
[/olist]  
Missions:  
[olist]  
 Second Mission:  
  
 Renamed from "Muggy and Buggy" to "I Know Why the Rum Is Gone".  
 Added dry tall grass, which slows player movement but can be burned with Molotovs.  
  
[/olist]  
  
Quality of Life Improvements  
  
Visual Adjustments:  
[olist]  
 Swamp color palette tweaked:  
  
 Shadows are now less dark for better visibility.  
 Reduced bloom for a more balanced aesthetic.  
  
[/olist]  
Performance Enhancements:  
[olist]  
 Grass has been improved in both visuals and performance.  
 New Level of Detail (LOD) optimizations on objects have improved FPS by ~30%.  
 Added adjustable resolution settings for better customization.  
[/olist]  
Gameplay Clarity:  
[olist]  
 Tooltips added to checkpoints to clarify icons for dangerous and extremely dangerous creatures.  
[/olist]  
  
Known Issues  
  
 Molotovs require further optimization and may cause minor lag.  
 Undead pirate AI is in its early stages and will need future adjustments. This is just the beginning of their development.  
 Loading screens may take some time to load. This is an issue that I am currently working on resolving soon.

notes.title: Minor Update/Hotfix 1.3
notes.content:
Quality of Life Changes  
  
Skip Checkpoint Mechanic: Skip checkpoint now only appears every 5 deaths (previously appeared every time).  
Sarcosuchus Fight Music: The Sarcosuchus (crocodile) area now features different music depending on the stage of the fight.  
Sarcosuchus Loading Improvements: Fixed an issue where the Sarcosuchus area would stutter upon first loading.  
Spinosaurus Loading Screen: Corrected an issue where the Spinosaurus loading screen looped the same music cue.  
New Skip Button: You can now skip the welcome message when you first boot the game by typing in "skip" (Will add an actual skip button soon)
  

Bug Fixes  
  
Crawler Enemy Animation: Fixed the Crawler enemy’s attack animation to no longer instantly damage the player.  
Crawler Hitboxes: Corrected the hitboxes on Crawlers for better accuracy and fairness.  
Spear Mechanics: Vastly improved the spear’s hitbox to reduce floating spears and improve usability.  
  

Spinosaurus Recoded and Reworked  
  
Geometry Adjustments: Improved Spinosaurus geometry to reduce player obstructions during encounters.  
Fairer Attack Logic: Reworked Spinosaurus AI logic to make its attacks more fair and reduce "laser-like" targeting of players.  
Clipping Improvements: Corrected Spinosaurus physics to minimize instances of clipping through walls.  
Developer Note:  
  
 After observing players' strategies, I noticed many attempted to outrun the Spinosaurus and optimize spear throws to pass the encounter. While the intended mechanic was to use the waterfall as a line-of-sight barrier, I’ve adjusted the gameplay to respect these alternate approaches.  
 Players can now more easily outrun the Spinosaurus as a viable option, though the waterfall strategy remains intact for those who prefer it.  
  
  

Final Announcement  
Thank you for playing the demo and providing feedback! This patch is likely the last hotfix before the content update for the demo.  

The upcoming content update will include:  
[olist]  
 New game mechanics.  
 Unlocking the "Muggy and Buggy" checkpoint at the start of the swamp level.  
 A new set of weapons, including a cool explosive weapon (details to come!).  
[/olist]  

Stay tuned for more surprises, and I’ll leave you with this teaser image. See you on Primal Island!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740118/39874e85e3cca8770471d475bea9e83c27209bf3.jpg

notes.title: Minor Update/Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
Quality of Life Changes
-Added an extra checkpoint after Spinosaurus waterfall sequence.

-Sarcosuchus (crocodile)  area no longer spawns previous boss battles if you backtrack on accident.

-Adjusted Spinosaurus area geometry to make it more clear on where to go.

notes.title: Launch Update/Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I want to thank you all for your first initial feedback for Pteranodon 2: Primal Island. Below I have what's been added to the game! 

Quality of Life Changes

-Added checkpoints between islands for the Sarcosuchus (Crocodile) area
-You can now skip to the next checkpoint if you die multiple times (not including the Spinosaurus) 
-New gui added to show large dinosaur threat type (Can it be scared away or killed?) WIP
-Boss fights are now more fair and behave more naturally.

Bug Fixes
-Invisible wall glitch near "my name isn't Dennis" has been fixed
-Spinosaurus area has been rebuilt (Spino doesnt walk through walls as much)
-Multiple geometry fixes have been added throughout the level.

Balance Changes
-Lowered health on Sarcosuchus (crocodile) area 
-Lowered the speed of the Sarcosuchus
-Blood no longer covers as much screen when player is badly hurt
-Player sprint duration slightly increased
-Styracosaurus sprint speed slightly reduced
-Styracosaurus health slightly reduced
-Spinosaurus speed slightly reduced
-Spinosaurus no longer needed to be a certain distance to roar. Now he roars when hit by a spear with a 2.75 cooldown - Player still needs to run away!
